# Matrix Sqrt

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

Take the principal square root of a positive diagonal matrix with diagonal 4 and 9. The diagonal of the result is 2 and 3.

## What this example demonstrates

Take the principal square root of a positive diagonal matrix with diagonal 4 and 9. The diagonal of the result is 2 and 3.
